address: 37F, Park Hyatt Hotel, 1366 Qianjiang Road, Shangcheng, Hangzhou, China Mainland
bio: With exquisite glass lanterns, glass screens and panoramic windows that welcome in river views, the high-ceilinged room is perfect for banquets and business dinners. The menu is dominated by Zhejiang classics, alongside some Cantonese dishes. The poetically named Sinking Fish, Falling Geese consists of white fish balls stuffed with bird's nest. The classic braised pork belly is thinly sliced and styled into a pagoda. Reservations recommended....
